_comment: Pterodactyl egg for the RyzeSMP Test Client + AI remote-control service. Import under a Nest, then create a server from it. Clones the ryze-test/ subdir of the Minecraft-mods repo.
name: RyzeSMP Test Client
author: noreply@anthropic.com
description: Browser remote Minecraft test client + MCP interface for AI-assisted RyzeSMP testing. Separate from the suggestions bot.
startup: cd /home/container; if [ ! -f dist/index.js ] || ! /usr/local/bin/node -e "require.resolve('fastify')" 2>/dev/null; then echo '[ryze-test] dependencies/build missing or incomplete - installing...'; { /usr/local/bin/npm ci --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund || /usr/local/bin/npm install --no-audit --no-fund; } && /usr/local/bin/npm run build && { /usr/local/bin/npm ci --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund || /usr/local/bin/npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund; }; fi; exec /usr/local/bin/node dist/index.js

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 make g++ || echo '[ryze-test] build toolchain unavailable; relying on prebuilt binaries'
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /tmp
rm -rf repo
git clone --depth 1 --branch "${BRANCH}" "${GIT_ADDRESS}" repo
[ -d repo/ryze-test ] || { echo "ryze-test/ not found on ${BRANCH}"; exit 1; }
cp -r repo/ryze-test/. /mnt/server/
cd /mnt/server
rm -rf node_modules dist .env data .auth-cache
# Install ALL deps (incl dev) so the TypeScript build can run, then build,
# then prune to production-only deps. No '|| true' — a failed install aborts.
npm ci --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund || npm install --no-audit --no-fund
npm run build
[ -f dist/index.js ] || { echo 'build failed: dist/index.js missing'; exit 1; }
# Re-install production-only deps deterministically (keeps dist, drops dev).
npm ci --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund || npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund
# Verify the critical runtime deps are actually present before first start.
node -e "require.resolve('fastify'); require.resolve('better-sqlite3'); require.resolve('@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/mcp.js')"
echo '[ryze-test] install + build OK; runtime dependencies verified.'

variables.name: Dashboard Password
variables.description: Owner login password for the web dashboard.

variables.name: JWT Secret
variables.description: Long random string used to sign dashboard sessions.

variables.name: MCP Token
variables.description: Bearer token every MCP client (Claude Code is primary) must present. Keep secret.

variables.name: MCP Allow Sessions
variables.description: true lets the primary AI MCP client (Claude Code) start/stop test sessions itself. Dangerous server commands still require owner approval.

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: Exact Java version of the target server (default 1.21.11). An empty or unsupported value falls back to 1.21.11; it is never passed through unvalidated.

variables.name: Safety Mode
variables.description: safe = dangerous commands need owner approval. open = no gate.

variables.name: Action Rate / min
variables.description: Max actions per minute per client.

variables.name: HTTP Port
variables.description: Dashboard/MCP HTTP port. Leave EMPTY to auto-use the server's primary allocation port (recommended). Only set a number if you proxy a different internal port.

variables.name: Debug MC Packets
variables.description: true logs login/configuration packet NAMES (never payloads) to diagnose a configuration-phase stall.

variables.name: Viewer Enabled
variables.description: true enables optional 3D render (needs native deps; heavier).
